description:
Advances: bw.signal.pipeline

Deliverable:
internal/signal/hooks.go: the four-moment runner (enrich → validate → gate → on-blocked → post-emit) via os/exec — signal record as stdin JSON with stdin closed after write, captured stdout/stderr buffers (never the TTY), BW_SIGNAL_TYPE/BW_SIGNAL_TICKET/BW_SIGNAL_MOMENT env scalars with parent env inherited, CWD = repo root, per-hook hook_timeout (default 30s; SIGTERM → grace → SIGKILL). Exit-code classifier: 0 allow; 1 deliberate block (stdout+stderr = refusal reason, on-blocked fires); >=2, killed, or timeout = MALFUNCTION (fail closed, distinct label, on-blocked does NOT fire). Enrich: exit 0 + stdout JSON object replaces payload; exit 0 + empty stdout = unchanged; non-zero or non-JSON stdout = malfunction. Repo-global + per-type hook resolution (enrich: global then type; gate: type then global, any block short-circuits); all four moments independently optional; zero hooks = valid config. Wire into cmdSignalEmit: hooks run ONCE outside commitWithRetry; enrich output feeds final validation; blocked/malfunction refuse before store with nothing persisted; post-emit runs after the durable commit — its failure prints WARNING and emit still exits 0. docs/design.md Signals section gains the hook I/O contract + exit-code table.

Verification:
- Tests to pass: TestPipelineEmitSequence, TestHookStdinJSONContract, TestOnBlockedFailureIsolated, TestHookTimeoutKilled (internal/signal); TestSignalHooksRunOnceUnderRetry, TestSignalEmitNoBypassFlag, TestSignalEmitHelpMentionsPipeline (cmd/bw); TestSignalGateBlocks, TestSignalHookMalfunction, TestSignalPostEmitWarning (test/)
- Behaviors to demonstrate: bw.signal.pipeline.attribution_pattern, bw.signal.pipeline.gate_blocks_red_tests, bw.signal.pipeline.broken_gate_not_bypass, bw.signal.pipeline.post_emit_failure_still_stored, bw.signal.pipeline.cas_retry_single_hook_run, bw.signal.pipeline.no_bypass_flag, bw.signal.pipeline.on_blocked_crash_isolated
- Verification cadence:
  - Iteration tier: implementers run compile-graph-scoped checks only (targeted `go test ./internal/signal/... ./cmd/bw/...`); no full suite mid-iteration.
  - Final tier: immediately before IMPLEMENTED, run `make preflight`, run-until-green.
  - Verifier tier: verifiers run flipped stubs and targeted selections only; do NOT run the full suite.
- Standing bounce-class checks:
  - Production call site named for each new callable surface, with the proving test that exercises that production path
  - Fixture/sandbox hygiene covered: temp hook scripts under t.TempDir, no cross-test env leakage (BW_SIGNAL_*, BW_SESSION_ID)
  - Spec surfaces kept fresh for every touched callable/config surface
  - Every conditional clause covered by a test (each exit-code class, each moment present/absent)
- Call-site Integration: cmdSignalEmit now invokes signal.RunPipeline around store. Proving tests: TestSignalGateBlocks (temp gate script exits 1 → emit exits non-zero, signals/<id>/ empty, on-blocked fired) and TestSignalHookMalfunction (sleep-999 gate → MALFUNCTION within hook_timeout, guarding the never-hang invariant).

Out of Scope (files):
- cmd/bw/signal_query.go, cmd/bw/show.go, internal/md/**, prompts/** (Stage 3)
- internal/issue/**, internal/intent/**, internal/treefs/** (storage landed in Stage 1)
Allowed touches (this stage may modify):
- internal/signal/hooks*.go
- internal/signal/hooks_test.go
- cmd/bw/signal.go
- cmd/bw/signal_test.go
- docs/design.md
- test/acceptance_test.go
- .spec/specs/signal_pipeline.spec.md (verification stub flips execute:false->true only)

Out of Scope (intent):
- No bypass flag or env switch for the pipeline — unskippability is the guarantee this stage exists to deliver.
- No core identity/session/attribution concept — attribution stays a repo enrich-hook pattern.
- No hook re-runs inside the CAS retry loop and no gate re-execution on contention.
- No throttling/cooldown state in core (cut in the spec); no on-blocked persistence by default.
- No interactive/TTY behavior in hooks — captured buffers only.

Merge gate:
- [ ] Code compiles cleanly
- [ ] Tests listed above pass
- [ ] Spec verification passes
- [ ] Scope check: diff touches only Allowed globs (mechanical)
- [ ] Auditor APPROVE comment on the ticket
title: S2: Unskippable hook pipeline
